title: Grateful Dead Live at Laguna Seca Recreation Area on 1988-07-30
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX90) Tascam 112MKII -> Korg MR-1, 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 48KHz -> Wave Lab 6.0 w/UAD -> R8brain for 16bit 44.1KHz sample rate conversion -> Traders Little Helper flac8
source: Nakamichi CM-100 mics with CP-1 caps (In Hat FOB) Sony WM-D6

ai_review.summary: Poorly recorded fan tape plagued by distracting side chatter, with no musical highlights noted
ai_review.review: This fan‑recorded (FOB) capture is dominated by excessive crowd chatter that obscures the music, making it difficult to appreciate any performance nuances. Reviewers did not mention any standout songs or strong playing, and the overall listening experience is judged unsatisfactory.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review giving a 2‑star rating; reviewer focuses on recording issues with no positive comments about the show, leading to a low overall score and low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Excessive side chatter and crowd noise dominate the mix; instruments are masked and clarity is low.
